players.product: Ovation control systems for power plants (fleet modernizations, new gas-fired capacity and behind-the-meter generation for data centers)

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K: estimated consolidated order backlog was $8.6 billion at September 30, 2025 ($8.4 billion a year earlier) - Intelligent Devices $4,499 million, Software and Control $4,130 million ($3,957 million) - with approximately 75 percent expected to be recognized as revenue over the next 12 months. Fiscal 2025 net sales were $18,016 million, up 3 percent from $17,492 million; capital expenditures were $431 million ($419 million). Fiscal 2026 outlook given in the 10-K: net sales up approximately 5.5 percent, underlying sales up approximately 4 percent, adjusted earnings per share $6.35 to $6.55.
quarterly_data.figure: backlog $8.6 billion (Sept 30, 2025); FY2025 net sales $18,016 million (+3%); capex $431 million; FY2026 outlook sales ~+5.5%, adjusted EPS $6.35-$6.55
